config.json.case_selection: Retrospective study endpoints and dates declared in advance. A case input is generated only if a saved positive OR alert exists within its scope. Dataset family labels are not selection criteria.

VM2.evaluation_limit: Saved test populations differ. Joint counts concern their intersection, not a shared full test set; selected VM3 examples are not a population estimate.

VM3.evaluation_limit: Saved test populations differ. Joint counts concern their intersection, not a shared full test set; selected VM3 examples are not a population estimate.

run_manifest.json.missing_prediction_policy: 1 OR unknown = 1; 0 OR unknown = unknown; unknown is never replaced with 0.

cases.context_rule: All available processed records matching the same endpoint and declared date scope, irrespective of model outcomes or family labels.
cases.historical_run_status: Earlier LLM runs used preselected cases; these newly generated inputs have not been submitted to Ollama by this script.
